title: Carbon Steel Cast Billet Ingots, Billets, Blooms and Slabs for Re-Rolling into Steel for General Structural Purposes — Specification
qco_name: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Mandatory Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Ministry of Steel

clauses.title: Chemical Composition Limits for Carbon Steel Billets
clauses.text: Clause 5.1 & Table 1 (Chemical Requirements): (a) Carbon (C) shall be between 0.10% and 0.25% for standard structural re-rolling. (b) Manganese (Mn) between 0.40% and 1.60%. (c) Sulphur (S) max 0.050%. (d) Phosphorus (P) max 0.050%. (e) (S+P) combined max 0.095%.
